newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha sheds early gains, buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha sheds early gains, buyers scarce.

text.p: European naphtha prices tracked early crude gains on Monday but prices softened as some of crude's strength was eroded by profit taking over the afternoon and end-users stayed out of the market, traders said.
Traders said the spot prices were mostly notional with relaxed buying interest keeping bids low while term contract pricing strategies kept offers high.
In NWE pipeline spec cargoes offered around mean of published quotes +$1.25 to +$1.50 found little buying interest.

In the Mediterranean, Moroccan barrels were still seen available at what some traders said was a high, pricing related, offer of $177 a tonne and expected to see little buying interest for the material.
They said Algerian fourth quarter term contract pricing was keeping sellers levels artificially high.
"The Moroccan barrels have been there since early last week but the price is more related to the Q4 pricing rather and is not an indication of any real strength," a trader said.
Best bids were notionally assessed $4-5 below this level.
